title: CheckRepository
description: Loads a check row by its name from the transaction's draft and saves it, in the check table only; Lathe's own rows load with the rest and are refused as built-in when a save would change or remove one.

title: ProductSettingRepository
description: Loads a product's settings row from the transaction's draft and saves it, in the product_setting table only.

title: SpaceRepository
description: Keeps the spaces as JSON in browser storage: `lathe:space` (local, the space chosen last), `lathe:space-pages` (session, each space's last page) and `lathe:space-rail` (local, whether two or more spaces were listed last time), loaded and saved whole.

title: NavRowRepository
description: Keeps which nav rows are open as JSON in browser storage: `lathe:nav-folders` (session, the stage and folder rows) and `lathe:nav-sections` (local, the nav's own sections), loaded and saved whole.

title: TabSetRepository
description: Keeps the window's tabs whole: every space's tab set under `lathe:tabs` and the view last set under `lathe:place` in session storage, the stage last chosen under `lathe:stage` in local storage, and each place's cameras in memory while the window is open.

title: SessionSettingsRepository
description: Keeps the Session settings as JSON under `lathe:session-settings` in session storage, loaded and saved whole; a stored value of another form reads as the defaults.

title: ViewRepository
description: Loads a view whole from the transaction's draft (its view requirements and their view tests, with the test data sets each starts from) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the View aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made.

title: EndpointRepository
description: Loads an endpoint whole from the transaction's draft (its API requirements and their endpoint tests, and its handler with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Endpoint aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made.

title: IntegrationRepository
description: Loads an integration whole from the transaction's draft (its adapter with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses, and its integration tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Integration aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made.

title: UiComponentRepository
description: Loads a UI component whole from the transaction's draft (the views it renders, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the UI component aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made.

title: DomainRepository
description: Loads a domain whole from the transaction's draft (its capabilities with what they serve, terms, domain services with their services and tests, and repositories with what they persist, meet and use) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Domain aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside a domain is loaded through the domain that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside references what goes.

title: SpecificationRepository
description: Loads a specification whole (its predicate and test, the aggregates it reads, and what they meet, use and start from) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A predicate or test is loaded through the specification that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming what references it, while anything left references it.

title: AggregateRepository
description: Loads an aggregate whole from the transaction's draft (its entities with their fields and the entities they hold, their data models with the standard rules they meet and the packages they use, and its invariants with their tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Aggregate aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside one is loaded through the root that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside what goes references it.

title: DomainEventRepository
description: Loads a domain event whole from the transaction's draft (its fields in order, and its event type with the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Domain event aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside one is loaded through the root that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside what goes references it.

title: CommandRepository
description: Loads a command whole from the transaction's draft (the events it raises, the specifications it checks and the domain services it calls, its handler, and its policies with the event each hears, their event handlers and tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Command aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside one is loaded through the root that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside what goes references it.

title: ValueObjectRepository
description: Loads a value object whole (its fields, constraints with their tests, and its value type, with what they meet, use and start from) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside a value object is loaded through the value object that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming what references it, while anything left references it.

title: ReadModelRepository
description: Loads a read model whole (its fields, queries with their handlers, its projection, and the links they start) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside a read model is loaded through the read model that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming what references it, while anything left references it.

title: StorageRequirementRepository
description: Loads a storage requirement whole (its storage requirement tests and the test data sets they start from) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a test is loaded through the requirement that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming what references it, while anything left references it.

title: PanelRepository
description: Keeps the nav's width and whether it is collapsed as JSON in local storage, `lathe:nav-width` and `lathe:nav-collapsed`, loaded and saved whole; the app works on without storage.

title: AppearanceRepository
description: Keeps the person's themes, the chosen theme, the color mode, Scroll to zoom and the chosen theme's stylesheet as JSON in local storage (`lathe:themes`, `lathe:theme`, `lathe:color-mode`, `lathe:scroll-to-zoom`, `lathe:theme-css`); the stylesheet is written with each save for index.html's early script.

title: ProductWindowRepository
description: Keeps the open windows in memory by folder, each window's place in window-state.json and the chrome colors in chrome.json in the shell's user data folder; the files are read on the first load and rewritten only when a save changes them.

title: AppServerRepository
description: Keeps the servers the shell runs and the stops in progress in memory, by folder, while the shell runs, and each folder's port in app-server-ports.json in the shell's user data folder, read on the first load and rewritten when a save changes it; each load returns a copy of the whole.

title: RecentFolderRepository
description: Keeps the recent folders, latest first, as a JSON list in recent-folders.json in the shell's user data folder, read on the first load and rewritten whole on each save.

title: ProductRepoConfigRepository
description: Keeps the product repo's lathe.config.json at its root: loadConfig and readConfig read it through load, and `lathe init` and `lathe upgrade` write it whole through save.

title: ShellSettingsRepository
description: Keeps the Shell settings as settings.json in the shell's user data folder, read whole on each load (the Owner may edit it by hand) and written whole on each save.

title: KeyBindingsRepository
description: Keeps the changed shortcuts as JSON in local storage under `lathe:keybindings`, each its keys or null for one left without a key, loaded and saved whole; a shortcut that cannot be bound or a malformed value is dropped as it loads, and the app works on without storage.

title: VoiceSettingsRepository
description: Keeps the Voice settings as JSON in local storage under `lathe:voice`, loaded and saved whole; a malformed value is dropped for the defaults (both modes off, "Lathe").

title: WindowChatRepository
description: Keeps the windows' chats and the stops in progress in memory, by folder, while the shell runs, and each folder's chat mode in chat-modes.json in the shell's user data folder; the file is read on the first load and rewritten only when a save changes it.

title: AgentSignInRepository
description: Keeps the Agent sign-in in memory while the shell runs, loaded and saved whole; nothing is written, as the agent keeps the credentials and says itself whether it is signed in.

title: ProductRepository
description: Loads a product whole from the transaction's draft (its roles, product kinds with their fields, product relations, and open questions with what they are about) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Product aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside a product is loaded through the product that holds it, and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside what goes references it.

title: BusinessOutcomeRepository
description: Loads a business outcome whole (its row and the measured_by links it starts) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its own tables only; a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while a capability serves it or anything else references it.

title: ExtensionRecordRepository
description: Loads one record of a product's own kind whole (its row, the links it starts and the packages it uses) and saves exactly the rows that changed; its tables are every product kind's table, package_use and the link tables of the relations a product kind may start, read from the transaction's schema, and for the shared ones only the rows its own record starts or names.

title: InterfaceRepository
description: Loads an interface whole from the transaction's draft (its row, the roles that use it in order, and the use cases it offers) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Interface aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside the interface references it.

title: JourneyRepository
description: Loads a journey whole (its row, its steps with the carries_out link each starts, its journey test with its starts_from links, and the serves links it starts) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its own tables only; removing a journey removes its steps and test, never what they carry out, and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything else references them.

title: StandardRepository
description: Loads a standard whole from the transaction's draft (its rules and rule tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Standard aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A rule or rule test is loaded through the standard that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside references what goes.

title: TableRepository
description: Loads a table whole (its keys, the standard rules it meets and the packages it uses) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A table is its own root, loaded by its ID, and a removal is refused, naming what references it, while anything left references it.

title: EntryPointRepository
description: Loads an entry point whole (its row, the package_use rows naming it and the meets links it starts) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its own tables only, and only its own record's rows of the shared package_use and meets tables.

title: ToolingRepository
description: Loads a tooling record whole (its row, the package_use rows naming it and the meets links it starts) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its own tables only, and only its own record's rows of the shared package_use and meets tables.

title: DataStoreRepository
description: Loads a data store whole (its row and the provided_by link it starts) from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in its aggregate's own tables only; a removal is refused, naming them, while a repository, reader or table is stored in it.

title: PatternFollowingRepository
description: Loads a following whole from the transaction's draft (the follows link and the setting values it gives) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the follows and setting_value tables only.

title: SlotFillingRepository
description: Loads a fill whole from the transaction's draft (its fills link) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the fills table only.

title: ProvisionRepository
description: Loads a record's provision whole from the transaction's draft (its provided_by link) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the provided_by table only.

title: TestDataSetRepository
description: Loads a test data set whole from the transaction's draft and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Test data set aggregate's own table only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while a test starts from it.

title: PatternRepository
description: Loads a pattern whole from the transaction's draft (its settings, rules and rule tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Pattern aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A rule or rule test is loaded through the pattern that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside references what goes.

title: UseCaseRepository
description: Loads a use case whole from the transaction's draft (its actors, UC requirements and their tests, flows, steps with the links they start, and flow tests) and saves exactly the rows that changed, in the Use case aggregate's own tables only; a write to any other table is refused when it is made (`DataFiles`). A record inside a use case is loaded through the use case that holds it (`loadHolding`), and a removal is refused, naming the referrers, while anything outside what goes references it.
